title: Self-Esteem and Body Image
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind self esteem and body image and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply self esteem and body image in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using self esteem and body image to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what self esteem and body image means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying self esteem and body image in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how self esteem and body image works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use self esteem and body image in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to self esteem and body image. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
